translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

book.name: 1 Corintios
book.title: Pablo Kepegin Jesúsgin-kwenamalad-Corintogin-pukmaladga Karta Palmijad 1 Corintios

content: Imi an tule-pimalad-kakagin tegin angelmal-kakagin an chunmakel, tenal an tulemal-pilaledgin an kwen chunmajulil, wedin anka ibga keg pel ku. Antin pinche pormo-koledyob tegin ezha-koledyob chunmadii.

Tegin an kurkin-purpaled nikal Pab-kaka-palchoggal, tegin an immal-choglemaid-pel-kwapa an mag itogel, tegin an pel-kwapa immal wijiil, tenal an tule-kwen-pilalzhulil, wedin anka ibga keg pel kubal. Tegin an pela-pela Pab-kwen-penzhulil akne yal onirgal, tenal an tule-kwen-pilalzhulil, wedin anka ibga keg pel kubal.
Tegin an tule-wilemaladga pel-kwapa immalmal-nikad ukel, tegin an naga chan ukmogal chogin okummogal, tenal an tulemal-kwen-pilalzhulil, wedin anka ib-nuedga kwen kuojul.

Imi an napírra tulemal-pilalel, an tulemalbak keg-chulgu pinnallé nane, tegin an keg-chulgu tulemalgin nugu-pinzhe, tegin an tulemalgin kwen nobzhulbal. Tenal an napírra tulemal-pilalel, an chunmakedgin naga otummojul, tegin an tummarba kwen itojulbal. Tenal an napírra tulemal-pilalel,
an kwinniganayob an kwen nanejul, tegin an naga tukingabi kwen pinzhejulbal. Tenal an napírra tulemal-pilalel, an keg pulzhuli-urwe, tegin tule-akpene-ankin-walmajadgin an kwen pal pinzhejulbal.
Tenal an napírra tulemal-pilalel, an nabir igal-iskana kwen takchul, tenal an yer igal-chunchunnad ito.

Tenal an napírra tulemal-pilalel, an akalzhul tulemalga wilego, tegin an tulegin kwen arpigojulbal. Tenal an napírra tulemal-pilalel, an pinzhedio tule kujal pul-nabir nanenoniko, tegin an pel-kwapa tulemal-abin-purtibalo.
Imi an napírra tulemal-pilalel, tule-pilalgued ilgwen-nadguo, pal kwen pelguojul-kuo. Tenal Pab-kaka-palchoged, tegin kaka-pimaladgin-chunmaked, tegin pirkin-immal-wijiid yabli pelgunoniko.
¿Ibiga an teob chog? Imi anmal iche-iche immal wis wismal, tegin anmal iche-iche Pab-kaka-palchogmal.
Tegin immal-innikigwad kujal nonikil, immal-imis-ampa-napimalad pelgunoniko.

Imi an toto-un, an machi-purwiganayob chunmadi-kus, an machi-purwiganayob pinzhedi-kus, an machi-purwiganayob ti-kusbal, an ampa nuekwá immal kwen wichul-nanas. Tenal an macheredga-kusgu, an purwigana-igal, an pél ebes.

Imi anmal ampa purpal nuekwa-immal-wichulidyob irmamalmo. Imis an purru-purru immal wis tak, tenal te ibegin an pakal-pud immal taknoniko. Tenal an imis ampa iche-iche immalmal wiis, an ampa pellallé immal kwen wichul. Tenal Pab Tummaddin an-nued-wisdo. Tenal te ibegin Pab-an-wijiidyob, an pela-pela immal wisgunonimogo.

Tenal pe Pab-penzhulidgin naneel, tegin pe Pabgin immal-nuegan abintakel, tegin pe tule-pilaledgin naneel, we igal-chogpágwad kwen pelguojul-kuo. Tenal we igal-chogpágwad choggwen pul-chunchoged: tule-pilaledgin-naneed.
